text:
secops-bot: DEPENDENCY ALERT — high severity CVE found in transitive dep 'github.com/fastjson/fastjson@v1.2.3' used by image redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-2. CVE-2026-1422. SBOM link: https://sbom.internal/redwood/runtime/2026-03-19-2 :rotating_light:

lisa (secops): saw this. scanner flagged the runtime image currently pushed to prod. severity = high, exploitability = public PoC noted.

alex (eng-infra): can we confirm which services build against that image? quick grep shows platform-runner + eval-worker.

miko (eng-sre): confirmed eval-worker on prod-edge-1 and prod-edge-2. Traffic small but still critical.

drew (platform): blocking rollout of any new runtime images immediately. Setting deploy freeze for repo infra/runtime. @deploy-bot can you hold merges?

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze applied to infra/runtime (branch: main). All CI pipelines for that repo are paused.

sam (eng-ml): is the vulnerability specific to a parser path we use? our ML runtime uses fastjson for offline feature parsing. Need quick triage if this affects inference path.

lisa (secops): initial triage: memory corruption in untrusted input parsing. We do use it for feature ingestion in a few services — treat as exploitable for data-plane.

security-oncall: I'm paged and joining. immediate actions: 1) quarantine affected image tag 2) rotate any ephemeral signing keys used by CI for that image 3) block current tag from deploy routing 4) start rebuild with patched dep.

ci-bot: Quarantine started: image redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-2 moved to quarantine registry at registry.internal/quarantine/runtime:2026-03-19-2.

alex (eng-infra): question on rotating keys — we sign images with KMS key projects/redwood-prod/kms/runtime-signing. Rotating will break current signed manifests if we don't re-sign. Do we want to revoke immediately or do a staged rotation?

lisa (secops): staged rotation. Revoke signing key versions used after we finish rebuilding and re-sign new images. But we should rotate CI ephemeral credentials that can push images. Also audit logs — enable detailed KMS audit for the key if not already.

drew (platform): action: restrict who can push to prod registry via RBAC. I'll create a temporary policy that only allows a small SA cluster-builder@redwood-prod. Add a canary allow for devops only.

miko (eng-sre): I'll update runtime's k8s admission policy to deny images with quarantined tags using ImagePolicy webhook. Patching now.

sam (eng-ml): for the rebuild: branch prepared that bumps fastjson to v1.2.4 (patched). I'll kick CI but want to ensure build uses pinned module versions. Also will run the internal fuzz harness.

ci-bot: CI build queued: infra/runtime#bugfix/fastjson-1.2.4. Tests: unit, integration, fuzz (smoke). Estimated ~18m.

lisa (secops): please also update SBOM for the new image and attach to the release notes. We need to push SBOM to https://sbom.internal and update the ticket.

security-oncall: create incident record in /incidents tracker with severity S2 (supply chain). Assign secops oncall + infra lead + platform lead.

alex (eng-infra): note re: KMS — we should not disable key versions until new images are signed. I'll prepare rotation plan: 1) create new key version 2) update CI to sign with new version for rebuilt images 3) re-sign and promote 4) revoke old version after 24h. Posting plan in #incidents.

drew (platform): RBAC change pushed: temporary registry write rule limited to cluster-builder@redwood-prod and devops-admins group. Will monitor for any blocked deploys.

miko (eng-sre): admission controller updated: webhook now rejects quarantined tags. Deployed to prod-edge.

sam (eng-ml): CI finished: build succeeded, tests ok, fuzz harness passed on quick run. New image pushed as registry.internal/runtime:2026-03-19-2-patched.

ci-bot: New image signed with KMS key version projects/redwood-prod/kms/runtime-signing/versions/42 and uploaded. SBOM uploaded: https://sbom.internal/runtime/2026-03-19-2-patched.

lisa (secops): good. Replacing runtime in prod with patched image via canary roll: will start with 5% traffic to eval-worker canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for eval-worker -> 5% on prod-edge-1. Monitoring health for 15m.

miko (eng-sre): health looks good on canary, no errors related to parsing now.

security-oncall: after a 30m observation window and no signs of exploitation, we can promote. Still leave old tag quarantined for forensic review.

drew (platform): promoted patched image to 100% and un-froze deploys. RBAC remains stricter for now until next week.

lisa (secops): follow-ups: - update dependency policy to block fastjson < 1.2.4 - add CI SBOM gating rule to block builds that include known CVEs - run org-wide SBOM sweep for any other usage - update incident postmortem with timeline and action owners.

sam (eng-ml): I'll open the PR for dependency policy and add a unit test to prevent regression.

alex (eng-infra): will schedule KMS key rotation and audit log review.

security-oncall: closing loop: incident severity downgraded to S3, postmortem task list created. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

lisa (secops): nice coordination, folks. Filing post-incident notes in #postmortems.
